teaching.title: Introductory Programming Teaching Assistant
bullets: Assisted introductory programming lab sessions covering variables and conditionals, as well as lists and arrays.
Answered student questions during office hours and helped organise assignment materials and submission records.

projects.title: Command-Line Text Utility
bullets: Implemented a small command-line text utility in C with explicit memory handling as a contribution to a team course project.
Used Git, checked array bounds and error paths, and traced program behaviour using a debugger.
